sentences.text:
For the Petitioners : Mr. Sunil Kumar Mahto, Advocate For the State : Mr. Amrit Raj Kisku,
Advocate For the NHAI : Mrs. Sweety Topno, Advocate ............
03/10.09.2024 :- Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned counsel for the respondent-State and learned counsel for the NHAI.
2. Prayer in the writ petition is made for direction upon the respondents to make payment of compensation to the petitioners for the acquired lands measuring .68 acres pertaining to plot no.
312 under khata 57 of thana no. 28, mouza-Sadmakala in Petarwar Block.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners have served representations however no decision has been taken as yet.
4. Learned counsels for the State and NHAI submits that the petitioners are having alternative remedy in the light of Section 3(H) 4 of National Highways Act, 1956.
5. In view of above this writ petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioners to avail alternative remedy under the National Highways Act, 1956.

Pending I.A., if any, stands disposed of.
( Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Satyarthi/
